title: 1987 Topps #684 Kent Tekulve Baseball Card Philadelphia Phillies
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText: This is a 1987 Topps baseball card featuring player Kent Tekulve of the Philadelphia Phillies. It is an original, non-autographed card from the Major League (MLB) set. The card number is 684 and it is part of the Modern (1970-Now) period. The card was manufactured by Topps Co. and is a single card in the 1987 Topps set.
